LanguageData.MT_RelocateDesc: Reinstall this same empty 3×3 turret base elsewhere. Its base upgrades, investment history and hit points are retained. Remove every head/module and clear all queued work, staged materials and ammunition first.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateWrecked: Only a surviving, operational turret base can be relocated.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateRemoveParts: Remove every head and module before relocating the base.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateClearOrders: Complete or cancel all queued assembly work before relocating the base.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateClearStock: Remove staged materials and unload all ammunition before relocating the base.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateOwnedSpawned: Select a placed turret base owned by your faction.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateCurrentFloor: View the base's current floor before planning its relocation.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateSelectOne: Select only this base to plan its relocation.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateOrderBlocked: Cancel the pending relocation or uninstall designation before adding assembly work.
LanguageData.MT_RelocateBackendFailed: [ModularTurrets] Empty-base relocation disabled because native protection is unavailable: {0}
